name: Project ReMind
description:
About This Game

Project ReMind is a story-driven first-person adventure puzzle game. You remember being the scientist who created Artificial Consciousness, but instead of taking over the world, it just disappeared. All your efforts in creating new ones result in the same outcome year after year. But, as you explore your memories you feel uneasy with something that doesn't really belong there, something extraneous and unrealistically calm, like if it were waiting for you.

HALF REMEMBERED, HALF UNKNOWN.

You awake in a world built from fragments of your past.

The deeper you dig in your memories, the more questions arise. Why can't you remember everything? Why are some memories altered? Where are you? Is this place made just of memories? The answers are along the path of your life, from a dystopian government, to the new hope of human life on the moon, following the signal your artificial consciousnesses have left for you.

These memories are a snapshots of the 21st Century's progress through the decades, as humanity grapples with its own destiny and identity till the dawn of the new century. But, something else is there, something that goes beyond your fears, love and passion, something that is not really part of you...

Will your obsession with the disappeared AGI lead you to meet the mysterious presence in your memories?

What will it say?

FEATURES

  • A stunning near-future world – breathtaking landscapes, megastructures, architectures and ruins handcrafted with meticulous care.

  • Deep exploration of your past – Drive your grandpa's boat, unlock secret passages, crawl into lunar tunnels to traverse your vast life.

  • A journey into the nature of consciousness, artificial and human. – a compelling narrative adventure in a mysterious island, with puzzles, secrets, and revelations from your past.

  • A cinematic adventure – discover a fractured past through narration and environmental storytelling.

  • Challenging puzzles – encounter immersive puzzles that intertwine with your own story.

  • Original soundtrack – Over 2 hours of original live-recorded music, that dynamically weaves your gameplay into the world's narrative.
short_desc: In this realistic first person puzzle game, you truly created Artificial Consciousness. Why it disappears just after creation with a simple goodbye is your obsessing mystery. Will you solve it within your shattered memories, even if they are altered by something not quite human?
